title: Giuseppe Coluccio
reason: Usable pages (OCCRP, France 24 via archive, Corriere, BBC, Globe and Mail, National Post 2013 and 2018, gangstersinc, cosanostranews) give only a few sourced paragraphs on Giuseppe himself: 2005 flight to Canada, 7 Aug 2008 arrest in Markham, immigration ruling, deportation to Rome on 20 Aug 2008, Operation Solare context. The rest concerns his brothers and Toronto clans. About 600 to 700 words of real content; padding refused. Original Italian sources (Repubblica, Globe 2008, Star) were not opened for lack of time and search/fetch limits.
